conversation_turns.user_message: We are deciding whether to launch a cheaper starter plan or keep our single plan. The goal is to grow monthly recurring revenue by 15% within twelve months.
conversation_turns.assistant_message:
I’ve mapped the two plans, plus a phased starter launch as an Olumi-suggested comparison. The first pass is provisional: it needs today’s MRR and the effects of starter-plan revenue and cannibalisation on total MRR before it can compare outcomes meaningfully.

Is your deadline 7 October 2027 (12 months from today)?

This comparison turns on the links from ‘Starter-plan monthly recurring revenue’ to ‘monthly recurring revenue’ and from ‘MRR lost to single-plan cannibalisation’ to ‘monthly recurring revenue’, whose strengths nobody has set yet. To size them, I first need today’s level of ‘monthly recurring revenue’. What is it, in currency/month?

I saved the model I drafted. What I proposed above is not made until you approve it. Questions this model does not answer yet: Does "monthly recurring revenue" get there within 12 months? The model holds no deadline yet, so no result answers that. "monthly recurring revenue" depends on "Starter-plan monthly recurring revenue", which Olumi reads as "Starter-plan monthly price" times "Starter-plan paying subscribers". (2 of 7 shown.)
